facts.fact: The General Information Authority issued version 1.1 of the National Policy for Government Data Governance in December 2022, covering the government data lifecycle, classification, sharing and ownership across all government bodies; the document gives no separate approval date, so its imprint month is used.
facts.system: National Policy for Government Data Governance

systems.system: National Policy for Government Data Governance

note: Policy text names GIA only as its author; it names no body to carry it out and issues no rule beyond itself, so no use fact.

claims.gtmi-151d28ff3a: nothing: the policy names GIA only as author; its 1993 establishment and dedicated role are not stated
